5:1.sourceText: Ὅλως ἀκούεται ἐν ὑμῖν πορνεία, καὶ τοιαύτη πορνεία ἥτις οὐδὲ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, ὥστε γυναῖκά τινα τοῦ πατρὸς ἔχειν.
5:1.targetText: Whoredom is actually heard of among you, and such whoredom as is not even named among the nations—as that one has the wife of the father!

groups.note: Actual Ὅλως is the generally/actually adverb, rendered actually; it is not an adjective modifying the named behavior.
Actual ἔχειν is a present active infinitive with τινα as its accusative personal subject, rendered finite has. The actual infinitive is not retagged third-person indicative.

unmappedTarget.reason: Checked TR adds an independently written naming predicate ὀνομάζεται here, while N1904 has no naming verb. This second is belongs to that extra English naming clause, not the actual initial hearing verb.
Checked TR prints the additional ὀνομάζεται naming predicate; no corresponding actual N1904 word is printed in this clause.

5:2.sourceText: καὶ ὑμεῖς πεφυσιωμένοι ἐστέ, καὶ οὐχὶ μᾶλλον ἐπενθήσατε, ἵνα ἀρθῇ ἐκ μέσου ὑμῶν ὁ τὸ ἔργον τοῦτο πράξας;
5:2.targetText: And you are having been puffed up, and did not rather mourn, that he may be removed out of the midst of you who did this work,

groups.note: Actual πεφυσιωμένοι is a perfect passive participle with the present being verb, retained as the English periphrastic are having been puffed up; no present puffing participle is substituted.
Actual ἀρθῇ is an aorist passive subjunctive of αἴρω, rendered he may be removed; checked TR has the taking-out compound instead. The actual simple source lemma and form remain.

Actual πράξας is an aorist active participle under the substantivizing article, rendered finite did with who. Checked TR has ποιήσας instead; the doing head is retained without replacing the actual πράσσω lemma.

unmappedSource.reason: The article before work is not separately expressed under the English this modifier.

5:3.sourceText: ἐγὼ μὲν γάρ, ἀπὼν τῷ σώματι παρὼν δὲ τῷ πνεύματι, ἤδη κέκρικα ὡς παρὼν τὸν οὕτως τοῦτο κατεργασάμενον
5:3.targetText: for I indeed, as being absent as to the body, and present as to the spirit, have already judged, as being present, him who so worked this thing:

groups.note: Actual dative article/body noun marks the respect expression, rendered as to the body; no independent as/to prepositions are printed in that constituent.
Actual dative article/spirit noun marks the parallel respect expression, rendered as to the spirit; it is not a source preposition pair.
Actual κατεργασάμενον is an aorist nonactive/deponent participle, rendered finite worked with the substantivizing him-who frame; its source participial form is unchanged.

unmappedTarget.reason: Checked TR adds ὡς before the first absent participle. N1904 has the absent participle without that independently written comparison word; the later actual ὡς belongs to the second presence comparison.

5:4.sourceText: ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ συναχθέντων ὑμῶν καὶ τοῦ ἐμοῦ πνεύματος σὺν τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ,
5:4.targetText: in the Name of our Lord Jesus Christ—you being gathered together, also my spirit—with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

groups.note: Actual συναχθέντων is an aorist passive participle in the genitive circumstance with you; English being gathered together retains that predicate without making it a present source form.

unmappedSource.reason: The article under my spirit is not separately expressed in English.

unmappedTarget.reason: Checked TR adds ἡμῶν to the first Lord-Jesus designation; N1904 has no first possessive here. The actual later ἡμῶν owns the second our only.
Checked TR adds Χριστοῦ to the first Lord-Jesus designation. N1904 has no corresponding Christ word here.
Checked TR adds Χριστοῦ to the second Lord-Jesus designation too. No actual Christ identity elsewhere is borrowed for this additional name.

5:5.sourceText: παραδοῦναι τὸν τοιοῦτον τῷ Σατανᾷ εἰς ὄλεθρον τῆς σαρκός, ἵνα τὸ πνεῦμα σωθῇ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ Κυρίου.
5:5.targetText: to deliver up such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the Day of the Lord Jesus.

unmappedTarget.reason: Checked TR adds Ἰησοῦ after Lord here. N1904 ends the actual designation with Lord and no neighboring Jesus occurrence is imported.

5:6.sourceText: Οὐ καλὸν τὸ καύχημα ὑμῶν. οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι μικρὰ ζύμη ὅλον τὸ φύραμα ζυμοῖ;
5:6.targetText: Your glorying [is] not good; have you not known that a little leaven leavens the whole lump?

groups.note: Actual οἴδατε has both raw analyses V-RAI-2P, a perfect-form knowing predicate. English have you known retains that actual form; this is not a separate Greek having verb.

unmappedSource.reason: The article under Your glorying is not separately expressed.

unmappedTarget.reason: English supplies the bracketed copula in the initial nominal glorying/good statement; no actual being verb is printed there.

5:7.sourceText: ἐκκαθάρατε τὴν παλαιὰν ζύμην, ἵνα ἦτε νέον φύραμα, καθώς ἐστε ἄζυμοι. καὶ γὰρ τὸ πάσχα ἡμῶν ἐτύθη Χριστός.
5:7.targetText: Cleanse out, therefore, the old leaven, that you may be a new lump, according as you are unleavened, for our Passover was sacrificed for us also—Christ,

groups.note: Actual ἦτε is present active subjunctive second-person plural, rendered you may be. The printed TR also includes this being word; omission from a tagged-word annotation is not evidence of absence from its printed Greek text. The actual N1904 form retains its own identity.
Actual πάσχα is the Passover designation, tagged ARAM in both pinned analyses.

unmappedSource.reason: The article under our Passover is not separately expressed.

unmappedTarget.reason: Checked TR prints additional οὖν after the cleansing command; N1904 has no corresponding inferential word here.
Checked TR adds ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν with the sacrifice clause. N1904 has no corresponding beneficiary phrase, and its actual our belongs to Passover rather than an extra sacrifice recipient.

5:8.sourceText: ὥστε ἑορτάζωμεν, μὴ ἐν ζύμῃ παλαιᾷ μηδὲ ἐν ζύμῃ κακίας καὶ πονηρίας, ἀλλ’ ἐν ἀζύμοις εἰλικρινίας καὶ ἀληθείας.
5:8.targetText: so that we may keep the celebration, not with old leaven, nor with the leaven of evil and wickedness, but with unleavened [bread] of sincerity and truth.

groups.note: Actual ἑορτάζωμεν is one present active subjunctive celebration/feast-observing verb, rendered we may keep the celebration; no separate keep verb or celebration noun is printed.
Actual ἀζύμοις is a substantival dative neuter plural unleavened adjective, rendered unleavened [bread]. No separately printed Greek bread noun is invented.

5:9.sourceText: Ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἐν τῇ ἐπιστολῇ μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι πόρνοις,
5:9.targetText: I wrote to you in the letter, not to keep company with whoremongers—

groups.note: Actual συναναμίγνυσθαι is a present nonactive infinitive, with functional V-PMN and formal V-PEN analyses, rendered the social-association expression to keep company with. It does not print independent keep/company/with words.

5:10.sourceText: οὐ πάντως τοῖς πόρνοις τοῦ κόσμου τούτου ἢ τοῖς πλεονέκταις καὶ ἅρπαξιν ἢ εἰδωλολάτραις, ἐπεὶ ὠφείλετε ἄρα ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελθεῖν.
5:10.targetText: and certainly not with the whoremongers of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or idolaters, seeing you ought then to go forth out of the world—

groups.note: Actual article/whoremongers dative constituent is the coordinated association complement, rendered with the whoremongers; no independent with preposition is printed here.
Actual article/covetous dative constituent is the next coordinated association complement, rendered with the covetous. The actual noun analysis N-DPM is retained.
Actual ἅρπαξιν has both raw analyses A-DPM and is substantival for extortioners; no independent Greek extortioner noun form is substituted.
Actual ἐπεί is a causal conjunction, rendered seeing; it is not a Greek visual-perception verb.
Actual ὠφείλετε is imperfect active indicative second-person plural, rendered you ought in the stated consequence; the actual past-form analysis is preserved rather than a present form.

unmappedSource.reason: Actual καί coordinates the covetous/extortioners, whereas checked TR and English have alternative or. These different connector heads remain explicit.

unmappedTarget.reason: Checked TR prints an additional initial καί; N1904 begins the statement with the actual not word and no initial coordinator.
English follows checked TR ἤ between covetous and extortioners, where N1904 prints καί.

5:11.sourceText: νῦν δὲ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι ἐάν τις ἀδελφὸς ὀνομαζόμενος ᾖ πόρνος ἢ πλεονέκτης ἢ εἰδωλολάτρης ἢ λοίδορος ἢ μέθυσος ἢ ἅρπαξ, τῷ τοιούτῳ μηδὲ συνεσθίειν.
5:11.targetText: and now, I wrote to you not to keep company with [him], if anyone, being named a brother, may be a whoremonger, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner—do not even eat together with such a one;

groups.note: Actual ὀνομαζόμενος is a present participle, with functional passive V-PPP-NSM and formal V-PEP-NSM analyses, rendered being named. Both actual source fields are retained.
Actual dative article/demonstrative identifies the eating companion, rendered with such a one; no separately printed with preposition or one noun is invented.

Actual συνεσθίειν is a present active eating-together infinitive under the prohibitive instruction, rendered English do ... eat together. The English do auxiliary belongs to that actual predicate, not a separate Greek doing verb or finite imperative tag.

unmappedTarget.reason: English supplies the bracketed association object before its conditional anyone clause; no independently printed matching him pronoun occurs there.

5:12.sourceText: τί γάρ μοι τοὺς ἔξω κρίνειν; οὐχὶ τοὺς ἔσω ὑμεῖς κρίνετε;
5:12.targetText: for what have I also to judge those outside? Do you not judge those within?

groups.note: Actual τί and dative μοι form a nominal question about the speaker’s relation to judging, rendered what have I. No Greek ἔχω having verb is printed; the whole question/dative frame, not a detached pronoun or article, owns the English verbal recast.
Actual κρίνετε is present active indicative second-person plural in a question, rendered Do ... judge; the auxiliary Do is not an independent Greek source word.

unmappedTarget.reason: Checked TR adds καί to the judging-outsiders question; N1904 has no corresponding additive word here.

5:13.sourceText: τοὺς δὲ ἔξω ὁ Θεὸς κρινεῖ. ἐξάρατε τὸν πονηρὸν ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν.
5:13.targetText: And judge those without God; and put away the evil from among yourselves.

groups.note: Actual article/outside adverb is the substantival outsider expression, rendered those without. This group does not include God, whose actual separate noun remains the subject of the Greek judging predicate.

Actual κρινεῖ is future active indicative third-person singular with God as its subject. Installed LSV and the pinned publisher USFM both print the bare word judge in this exact word order. This is lexical judging-head correspondence only: no imperative or human subject is assigned to the original, and the displayed English text is not silently repaired. Checked TR has present κρίνει, also with God as subject.
Actual ἐξάρατε is an aorist active imperative of removing/putting-away, rendered put away; checked TR instead has future ἐξαρεῖτε. The actual source form stays imperative.
Actual article and masculine singular evil adjective form a substantival expression, rendered the evil; no independent evil noun is printed.
Actual second-person genitive ὑμῶν and personal αὐτῶν intensifier jointly express yourselves; both raw αὐτῶν analyses are personal P-GPM, not a substituted reflexive form.

unmappedSource.reason: The article before the actual God subject is not separately expressed.

unmappedTarget.reason: Checked TR prints a coordinator before its second expulsion predicate; N1904 goes directly to the actual imperative without that extra and.
